public_definitions: Goal: Review the monthly solar generation dashboard and decide whether May should be handled as a standard low-output case or escalated as a critical low-output anomaly for this reporting cycle.
Primary field label: May low-output route
Options: Route May to standard low-output follow-up, Escalate May to critical low-output anomaly review, Send May to background monthly record filing
Page instructions: Use the monthly solar generation dashboard as the evidence source for deciding the appropriate May low-output severity route for this reporting cycle.
